name: 郭忠義
objective: 課程涵蓋計算機處理器之基本結構原理及設計，包括速度與效能、指令集、組合語言、算術單元、暫存器、流水線處理器等。透過此課程，學生可學習到計算機微處理器原理、設計與基本架構。
課程進度(1-16週):
Week 01 (09/07, 09/11) Computer Abstractions and Technology
Week 02 (09/14, 09/18) Computer Abstractions and Technology
Week 03 (09/21, 09/25) Instructions: Language of the Computer (Moon Festival, 09/25)
Week 04 (09/28, 10/02) Instructions: Language of the Computer, Quiz#1 (Teachers' Day, 09/28)
Week 05 (10/05, 10/10) Instructions: Language of the Computer (National Day, 10/10)
Week 06 (10/12, 10/16) Instructions: Language of the Computer, Quiz#2
Week 07 (10/19, 10/23) Arithmetic for Computer
Week 08 (10/25, 10/30) Midterm (Retrocession Day, 10/25)
Week 09 (11/02, 11/06) Arithmetic for Computer
Week 10 (11/09, 11/13) Processor: Datapath and Control (School Anniversary Compensatory Holiday, 11/09)
Week 11 (11/16, 11/20) Processor: Datapath and Control
Week 12 (11/23, 11/27) Processor: Datapath and Control, Quiz#3
Week 13 (11/30, 12/04) Processor: Datapath and Control
Week 14 (12/07, 12/11) Processor: Datapath and Control
Week 15 (12/14, 12/18) Processor: Datapath and Control, Quiz#4
Week 16 (12/21, 12/25) Final (12/21, 17:00~20:00) (Constitution Day, 12/25)
Week 17 (12/28, 01/01) Flexible Learning (New Year's Day, 01/01)
Week 18 (01/04, 01/08) Flexible Learning

materials: David A. Patterson and John L. Hennessy, “Computer Organization and Design: The Hardware / Software Interface”, 5th Ed., Morgan Kaufmann.
延伸教學與資源: ● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching) 強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.● 數位教材資源應用 (Application of Digital Resources) 採用影音多媒體或具開放授權之資源（如 OCW、開放教科書）作為主要或輔助教材。Adopts multimedia or open-licensed resources (e.g., OCW, Open Textbooks) as primary or supplementary teaching materials.
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG1：消除貧窮（No Poverty）SDG2：消除飢餓（Zero Hunger）SDG4：優質教育（Quality Education）SDG8：尊嚴就業與經濟發展（Decent Work and Economic Growth）SDG10：減少不平等（Reduced Inequalities）
課程是否導入AI: ● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）
remarks:
17 至 18 週彈性學習 / Flexible Learning
一、類別
學生分組實作及討論。
線上數位教材學習。
二、內容
(1) 第 17 週: 各組針對競賽建置系統，全班參與比賽。
(2) 第 18 週: 針對 17 週各組競賽，各組歸納出一份簡報，並在課堂中報告。
三、時數
總共 6 小時。
四、學習成果
第 16 週課程結束前各組須繳交第 17 週競賽系統規劃報告；第 18 週上課前需繳交歸納簡報。
五、評量比例
(1) 書面報告與簡報: 5%
(2) 17-18 週課堂報告表現: 5%
